blocks.zh: 生命週期持續回顧、效益與參考文獻
blocks.en: Ongoing Lifecycle Review, Benefits, and References

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Explain why excipient risk assessment is a living document requiring periodic and event-triggered review — 說明為何賦形劑風險評估是需要定期及事件驅動回顧的「活文件」
blocks.en: Explain why excipient risk assessment is a living document requiring periodic and event-triggered review

blocks.zh: Identify and categorize all triggers that mandate a reassessment under TR54-6 Section 7.1 — 識別並分類觸發重新評估的所有事件
blocks.en: Identify and categorize all triggers that mandate a reassessment under TR54-6 Section 7.1

blocks.zh: Articulate the business and regulatory value of a formalized excipient risk assessment program — 闡述正式化賦形劑風險評估的商業與法規價值
blocks.en: Articulate the business and regulatory value of a formalized excipient risk assessment program

blocks.zh: Locate and interpret the key regulatory and industry standards cited in Section 9.0 (EU GMP, ICH Q9, EXCiPACT, USP <1078>, IPEC GMP Guide) — 定位並解讀第9節引用的主要法規與業界標準
blocks.en: Locate and interpret the key regulatory and industry standards cited in Section 9.0 (EU GMP, ICH Q9, EXCiPACT, USP <1078>, IPEC GMP Guide)

blocks.zh: Apply the lifecycle review frequency decision logic based on excipient risk tier — 根據賦形劑風險等級應用生命週期回顧頻率決策邏輯
blocks.en: Apply the lifecycle review frequency decision logic based on excipient risk tier

blocks.zh: 持續回顧 — 正式風險評估生命週期
blocks.en: Ongoing Review — The Formal Risk Assessment Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念：活文件與生命週期管理
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Living Document and Lifecycle Management

blocks.zh: 什麼是「活文件」(Living Document)?
blocks.en: What Is a "Living Document"?

blocks.zh: Lifecycle Management（生命週期管理）的核心觀念是：風險評估不是「做一次就結束」的靜態文件，而是持續更新的活文件。這與 ICH Q10《藥品品質系統》的哲學一致——品質應透過整個產品生命週期持續監控與改進。
blocks.en: The core idea of Lifecycle Management is that a risk assessment is not a static document that is "done once and finished" but a living document that is continuously updated. This is consistent with the philosophy of ICH Q10, Pharmaceutical Quality System: quality should be continuously monitored and improved throughout the whole product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 可以把它想成汽車的維修記錄：你不只在買車時做一次檢查，每次更換零件、發生事故或達到里程碑時，都需要更新紀錄。賦形劑風險評估也是如此。
blocks.en: Think of it as a car's maintenance record: you do not inspect the car only once at purchase; every time a part is replaced, an accident occurs, or a mileage milestone is reached, the record needs to be updated. The same applies to an excipient risk assessment.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 QRM 框架要求持續監控風險控制的有效性
blocks.en: The ICH Q9 QRM framework requires ongoing monitoring of the effectiveness of risk controls

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 PQS 框架要求建立知識管理系統，使風險評估能隨新知識演進
blocks.en: The ICH Q10 PQS framework requires a knowledge management system so that risk assessments can evolve with new knowledge

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15（查驗/驗證）也強調定期回顧是法規期望
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 (Qualification and Validation) also emphasizes that periodic review is a regulatory expectation

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車保險年度回顧
blocks.en: Analogy: The Annual Review of Car Insurance

blocks.zh: 你的汽車保險不會永久不變——每年要回顧保費、保障範圍是否合適。當你「搬家」（新廠址）、「換新車」（新供應商）或「出了事故」（品質異常）時，你會立刻重新評估風險，而不是等到年度回顧。
blocks.en: Your car insurance does not stay the same forever; every year you review whether the premium and coverage are still appropriate. When you "move house" (new manufacturing site), "buy a new car" (new supplier), or "have an accident" (quality event), you reassess the risk immediately rather than waiting for the annual review.

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的邏輯完全相同：定期回顧（如同年度保險審查）+ 觸發事件回顧（如同發生重大事件後立即重評）。
blocks.en: The logic of TR54-6 is exactly the same: periodic review (like the annual insurance review) + trigger-event review (like an immediate reassessment after a major event).

blocks.zh: 觸發因素：何時必須重新評估？
blocks.en: Triggers: When Must You Reassess?

blocks.zh: 必須記住的六大關鍵觸發因素
blocks.en: The Six Key Triggers You Must Remember

blocks.zh: 這六類觸發因素是考試與實際工作中最常被測試的知識點：
blocks.en: These six categories of triggers are the knowledge points most often tested in examinations and in real work:

blocks.zh: 供應商變更 — 新的製造商/供應商，或現有供應商的 GMP 認證狀態改變
blocks.en: Supplier change — a new manufacturer/supplier, or a change in an existing supplier's GMP certification status

blocks.zh: 規格變更 — 賦形劑規格或藥典標準的修訂（Pharmacopeial changes）
blocks.en: Specification change — a revision of the excipient specification or of a pharmacopeial standard (Pharmacopeial changes)

blocks.zh: 法規行動 — 主管機關的召回、警告信、法規要求更新
blocks.en: Regulatory action — a recall or warning letter from a competent authority, or updated regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 新安全資訊 — 出現新的毒理學資料或業界安全事件（如 TSE 疫情）
blocks.en: New safety information — new toxicological data or an industry safety event (such as the TSE outbreak)

blocks.zh: 稽核發現 — 內部稽核或外部查廠發現供應商存在系統性缺陷
blocks.en: Audit findings — an internal audit or external inspection finds systemic deficiencies at the supplier

blocks.zh: 產品配方變更 — 現有產品的新配方，或全新產品使用現有賦形劑
blocks.en: Product formulation change — a new formulation of an existing product, or a completely new product that uses an existing excipient

blocks.zh: 任何一項觸發均強制要求重新評估，且過程、決策與理由必須文件化。
blocks.en: Any one trigger mandates a reassessment, and the process, decisions, and rationale must be documented.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務情境：FDA 警告信觸發流程
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario: The FDA Warning Letter Trigger Process

blocks.zh: 假設你是 CDMO，賦形劑供應商 X 收到 FDA 警告信，指出其 GMP 系統存在重大缺陷。TR54-6 要求的觸發回應步驟如下：
blocks.en: Suppose you are a CDMO and excipient supplier X receives an FDA warning letter citing major deficiencies in its GMP system. The trigger response steps required by TR54-6 are as follows:

blocks.zh: 立即啟動 — 警告信發出當日，正式啟動 Risk Review，記錄觸發事件
blocks.en: Initiate immediately — on the day the warning letter is issued, formally start a Risk Review and record the trigger event

blocks.zh: 現有庫存評估 — 審查已驗收入庫的批次，判斷是否有品質疑慮
blocks.en: Assess existing inventory — review batches already received and stored, and determine whether there are quality concerns

blocks.zh: 增強測試 — 對後續進貨批次實施強化放行測試，直至風險釐清
blocks.en: Enhanced testing — apply strengthened release testing to subsequent incoming batches until the risk is clarified

blocks.zh: 替代供應商資格確認 — 啟動備用供應商的 Supplier Qualification 程序
blocks.en: Qualify an alternative supplier — start the Supplier Qualification process for a backup supplier

blocks.zh: 法規通知評估 — 評估是否需要通知藥品主管機關（視藥證要求而定）
blocks.en: Regulatory notification assessment — assess whether the drug regulatory authority needs to be notified (depending on the marketing authorization requirements)

blocks.zh: CAPA 更新 — 將此事件納入 CAPA 系統，並更新供應商評估記錄
blocks.en: CAPA update — enter the event into the CAPA system and update the supplier assessment record

blocks.zh: 回顧頻率決策邏輯
blocks.en: Review Frequency Decision Logic

blocks.zh:
風險等級決定定期回顧週期：

HIGH RISK 高風險賦形劑
  → 年度回顧 (Annual Review)
  → 例：注射用賦形劑、功能性賦形劑、
       單一來源供應商

MEDIUM RISK 中風險賦形劑
  → 兩年回顧 (Biennial Review)
  → 例：多來源供應商、非關鍵功能

LOW RISK 低風險賦形劑
  → 三年回顧 (Triennial Review)
  → 例：通用輔料、多家認可供應商

+ 任何觸發事件 → 立即啟動計畫外回顧
  (Unscheduled / Event-Triggered Review)
blocks.en:
The risk level determines the periodic review cycle:

HIGH RISK excipients
  → Annual Review
  → e.g., injectable excipients, functional excipients,
       single-source suppliers

MEDIUM RISK excipients
  → Biennial Review
  → e.g., multi-source suppliers, non-critical functions

LOW RISK excipients
  → Triennial Review
  → e.g., commodity excipients, multiple approved suppliers

+ Any trigger event → start an unscheduled review immediately
  (Unscheduled / Event-Triggered Review)

blocks.zh: 此邏輯與 ICH Q9 的風險比例原則（proportionate risk management）一致：高風險 = 更頻繁的監控。
blocks.en: This logic is consistent with the ICH Q9 principle of proportionate risk management: higher risk = more frequent monitoring.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 1
blocks.en: Practice Question 1

blocks.zh: 你的賦形劑供應商通知你，其生產廠址將從德國遷移至印度。根據 TR54-6 Section 7.1，這是否構成觸發事件？如果是，請列出至少三個你需要在重新評估中考量的新風險面向。
blocks.en: Your excipient supplier notifies you that its manufacturing site will be relocated from Germany to India. According to TR54-6 Section 7.1, does this constitute a trigger event? If so, list at least three new risk aspects you need to consider in the reassessment.

blocks.zh: 提示：考慮「Change to site」、「Change in supply chain」、「Change in GMP certification status」三個觸發因素同時成立的情況。
blocks.en: Hint: consider the case in which the three triggers "Change to site", "Change in supply chain", and "Change in GMP certification status" all apply at the same time.

blocks.zh: 效益與價值 / QRM / 知識管理
blocks.en: Benefits and Value / QRM / Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: 效益解析：為何值得投入？
blocks.en: Benefits Explained: Why Is the Investment Worthwhile?

blocks.zh: 知識管理 (Knowledge Management) 的本質
blocks.en: The Essence of Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management 在此脈絡中的意義是：建立一個結構化的賦形劑風險資料庫，隨時間累積「機構智慧」，使每次決策都比上一次更有依據。
blocks.en: In this context, Knowledge Management means building a structured excipient risk database that accumulates "institutional wisdom" over time, so that each decision is better founded than the last.

blocks.zh: 這個資料庫包含：
blocks.en: This database includes:

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核歷史記錄（Supplier audit history）
blocks.en: Supplier audit history

blocks.zh: 分析證書趨勢分析（CoA trend analysis）
blocks.en: CoA trend analysis

blocks.zh: 客訴記錄與根本原因分析（Complaint records & RCA）
blocks.en: Complaint records & RCA

blocks.zh: 變更通知記錄（Change notification log）
blocks.en: Change notification log

blocks.zh: 各批次風險評分變化趨勢
blocks.en: Trends in risk scores across batches

blocks.zh: 隨著時間累積，這個資料庫讓你能在幾小時內完成新產品的賦形劑風險評估，而非從零開始花費數週。這就是「主動式（proactive）」vs「被動式（reactive）」風險管理的差異。
blocks.en: As it accumulates over time, this database lets you complete an excipient risk assessment for a new product in a few hours rather than spending weeks starting from scratch. This is the difference between proactive and reactive risk management.

blocks.zh: 比喻：信用評分系統
blocks.en: Analogy: The Credit Score System

blocks.zh: 想像銀行的信用評分（Credit Score）系統：每次你的供應商完成一筆交易（準時交貨、CoA 合格）就累積「信用」；每次發生品質事件（批次拒絕、遲交）就扣分。長期累積後，你對每個供應商的「風險評分」越來越精準。
blocks.en: Think of a bank's credit score system: every time your supplier completes a transaction (on-time delivery, conforming CoA) it accumulates "credit"; every time a quality event occurs (batch rejection, late delivery) points are deducted. Accumulated over a long period, your "risk score" for each supplier becomes more and more accurate.

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的 Knowledge Management 正是建立這樣一套供應商「信用歷史」——讓採購、品保、法規事務部門能用共同的數字語言溝通，而非各自憑直覺判斷。
blocks.en: The Knowledge Management in TR54-6 builds exactly this kind of supplier "credit history", so that Procurement, QA, and Regulatory Affairs can communicate in a common numerical language rather than each relying on their own intuition.

blocks.zh: 法規合規價值：三大主管機關期望
blocks.en: Regulatory Compliance Value: Three Major Regulatory Expectations

blocks.zh: 正式化賦形劑風險評估直接回應以下法規要求：
blocks.en: A formalized excipient risk assessment directly responds to the following regulatory requirements:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15（查驗/變更控制）：要求持續回顧與文件化，與 TR54-6 生命週期模型直接對應
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 (Qualification/Change Control): requires ongoing review and documentation, which corresponds directly to the TR54-6 lifecycle model

blocks.zh: EU EC Guidelines (2015)：明確要求對賦形劑供應商實施「正式化風險評估」以確定適用 GMP 等級，TR54-6 正是其實施指引
blocks.en: EU EC Guidelines (2015): explicitly require a "formalized risk assessment" of excipient suppliers to determine the appropriate GMP level; TR54-6 is precisely the implementation guidance for it

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 QRM：要求風險管理為持續性活動，而非單次評估；TR54-6 的觸發機制正是此要求的操作化
blocks.en: ICH Q9 QRM: requires risk management to be an ongoing activity rather than a one-time assessment; the trigger mechanism of TR54-6 operationalizes this requirement

blocks.zh: 在稽核中，能展示一套成熟的 Lifecycle Management 系統，代表法規成熟度（regulatory maturity）與品質文化的具體證明。
blocks.en: In an audit, being able to demonstrate a mature Lifecycle Management system is concrete evidence of regulatory maturity and quality culture.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 2
blocks.en: Practice Question 2

blocks.zh: 你的公司管理層質疑：「我們已經有供應商稽核程序了，為何還需要額外建立正式化賦形劑風險評估系統？」請根據 TR54-6 Section 8.0 列舉至少三個理由，說明正式化 RA 提供了稽核程序之外的附加價值。
blocks.en: Your company's management asks: "We already have a supplier audit program, so why do we need to build a formalized excipient risk assessment system on top of it?" Based on TR54-6 Section 8.0, list at least three reasons that explain the added value a formalized RA provides beyond the audit program.

blocks.zh: 提示：從「新產品評估速度」、「主動 vs 被動」、「共同語言」等角度思考。
blocks.en: Hint: think in terms of "speed of assessing new products", "proactive vs. reactive", and "common language".

blocks.zh: 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 關鍵參考文獻解析
blocks.en: Key References Explained

blocks.zh: Ref. 2 — EU EC Guidelines (2015)：TR54-6 的法規根基
blocks.en: Ref. 2 — EU EC Guidelines (2015): The Regulatory Foundation of TR54-6

blocks.zh: 這是整個 TR54-6 最直接的監管依據。2015年歐盟指引明確要求藥品持有人對賦形劑供應商執行「正式化風險評估」，以判斷應適用哪個等級的 GMP 標準。TR54-6 即為此指引的產業實施工具。
blocks.en: This is the most direct regulatory basis for the whole of TR54-6. The 2015 EU guidelines explicitly require the marketing authorization holder to perform a "formalized risk assessment" of excipient suppliers to determine which level of GMP standard should apply. TR54-6 is the industry implementation tool for these guidelines.

blocks.zh: 對應考點：EU 2015年指引 = TR54-6 的存在理由 (raison d'être)。
blocks.en: Exam point: the 2015 EU guidelines = TR54-6's raison d'être.

blocks.zh: Ref. 3 — PIC/S Guidelines (2018)：國際採納
blocks.en: Ref. 3 — PIC/S Guidelines (2018): International Adoption

blocks.zh: PIC/S（藥品查驗互認合作組織）2018年採用與 EU 相似的正式化賦形劑風險評估要求，代表此方法已獲多個主管機關認可，包括台灣的 TFDA 在內的 PIC/S 成員國均受影響。
blocks.en: In 2018 PIC/S (the Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme) adopted formalized excipient risk assessment requirements similar to those of the EU, which shows that this approach has been recognized by multiple regulatory authorities; PIC/S member countries, including Taiwan's TFDA, are all affected.

blocks.zh: 對台灣製藥業的意義：TWi Pharmaceuticals 等 CDMO 如有 EU 或 PIC/S 成員國客戶，均須符合此要求。
blocks.en: Significance for the Taiwan pharmaceutical industry: CDMOs such as TWi Pharmaceuticals must comply with this requirement if they have customers in the EU or PIC/S member countries.

blocks.zh: Ref. 7 — ICH Q9 QRM (2005)：風險管理哲學框架
blocks.en: Ref. 7 — ICH Q9 QRM (2005): The Philosophical Framework of Risk Management

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management 與 Risk Review 的理論基礎。ICH Q9 確立了製藥業 QRM 的五步驟框架（風險識別→分析→評估→控制→溝通/回顧），TR54-6 的生命週期模型正是 Q9 在賦形劑領域的具體落實。
blocks.en: The theoretical basis for Knowledge Management and Risk Review. ICH Q9 established the five-step QRM framework for the pharmaceutical industry (risk identification → analysis → evaluation → control → communication/review), and the lifecycle model of TR54-6 is the concrete application of Q9 in the excipient field.

blocks.zh: Ref. 13 — EXCiPACT (2017)：供應商認證標準
blocks.en: Ref. 13 — EXCiPACT (2017): Supplier Certification Standard

blocks.zh: EXCiPACT 是專為賦形劑供應商設計的第三方 GMP/GDP 認證標準，在 EU 已被許多 MAH 採用作為供應商資格確認工具。取得 EXCiPACT 認證的供應商，在 TR54-6 風險評估中通常可獲得較低的「製造商品質系統」風險評分。
blocks.en: EXCiPACT is a third-party GMP/GDP certification standard designed specifically for excipient suppliers, and it has been adopted by many MAHs in the EU as a supplier qualification tool. A supplier with EXCiPACT certification can usually obtain a lower "manufacturer quality system" risk score in a TR54-6 risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 實務提示：若供應商有 EXCiPACT 認證，可在 Section 5.0 的評估矩陣中降低 GMP 合規風險得分。
blocks.en: Practical tip: if a supplier has EXCiPACT certification, the GMP compliance risk score can be lowered in the assessment matrix of Section 5.0.

blocks.zh: Ref. 14 — NSF/IPEC/ANSI 363 (2016)：美國 GMP 標準
blocks.en: Ref. 14 — NSF/IPEC/ANSI 363 (2016): The US GMP Standard

blocks.zh: 這是美國市場對賦形劑 GMP 的主要標準，由 NSF International 與 IPEC 共同制定。對於供應美國市場的產品，可用此標準評估賦形劑供應商的 GMP 合規性，作為 TR54-6 製造商評估的依據之一。
blocks.en: This is the main GMP standard for excipients in the US market, jointly developed by NSF International and IPEC. For products supplied to the US market, this standard can be used to evaluate the GMP compliance of excipient suppliers, as one basis for the manufacturer assessment in TR54-6.

blocks.zh: Ref. 15 — Joint IPEC-PQG GMP Guide (2017)：業界最佳實踐
blocks.en: Ref. 15 — Joint IPEC-PQG GMP Guide (2017): Industry Best Practice

blocks.zh: IPEC 與英國藥品品質集團（PQG）聯合發布的 GMP 指南，是全球賦形劑製造商自願遵循的最高業界標準。在風險評估中，符合 IPEC-PQG GMP Guide 的供應商代表品質管理體系成熟度高，可在風險矩陣中獲得正面加權。
blocks.en: The GMP guide jointly published by IPEC and the Pharmaceutical Quality Group (PQG) of the UK is the highest voluntary industry standard followed by excipient manufacturers worldwide. In a risk assessment, a supplier that complies with the IPEC-PQG GMP Guide demonstrates a high level of quality management system maturity and can receive a favorable weighting in the risk matrix.

blocks.zh: Ref. 17 — USP <1078>：賦形劑 GMP 的藥典標準
blocks.en: Ref. 17 — USP <1078>: The Pharmacopeial Standard for Excipient GMP

blocks.zh: 美國藥典 USP General Chapter <1078> 是美國市場賦形劑 GMP 的藥典依據，與 IPEC-PQG GMP Guide 互補。對美國 NDA/ANDA 持有者，USP <1078> 合規是供應商評估的基準要求。
blocks.en: USP General Chapter <1078> is the pharmacopeial basis for excipient GMP in the US market and complements the IPEC-PQG GMP Guide. For US NDA/ANDA holders, compliance with USP <1078> is a baseline requirement for supplier assessment.

blocks.zh: 記憶技巧：1078 = USP 賦形劑 GMP（1059 是賦形劑性能，1078 是賦形劑 GMP）。
blocks.en: Memory aid: 1078 = USP excipient GMP (1059 is excipient performance, 1078 is excipient GMP).

blocks.zh: Ref. 24 — EU GMP Annex 1 (2008)：無菌製造要求
blocks.en: Ref. 24 — EU GMP Annex 1 (2008): Sterile Manufacturing Requirements

blocks.zh: 雖然 Annex 1 主要規範無菌製藥環境，但其對滅菌驗證、環境監控與供應鏈控制的要求，對注射用賦形劑（如無菌賦形劑溶液）的風險評估特別相關。使用無菌賦形劑的製造商，需在風險評估中納入 Annex 1 的合規要求。
blocks.en: Although Annex 1 mainly governs sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing environments, its requirements for sterilization validation, environmental monitoring, and supply chain control are particularly relevant to the risk assessment of excipients for injectables (such as sterile excipient solutions). Manufacturers that use sterile excipients need to include Annex 1 compliance requirements in the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 3
blocks.en: Practice Question 3

blocks.zh: 某口服固體劑型的賦形劑供應商聲稱其品質系統符合 ISO 9001:2015（Ref. 27），但未取得任何藥品 GMP 認證。根據 TR54-6 的參考標準體系，ISO 9001 能否作為充分的 Supplier Qualification 依據？請說明理由，並指出哪些額外標準（列舉 Ref. 編號）更適合作為評估基礎。
blocks.en: An excipient supplier for an oral solid dosage form claims that its quality system complies with ISO 9001:2015 (Ref. 27) but holds no pharmaceutical GMP certification. According to the reference standards framework of TR54-6, can ISO 9001 serve as a sufficient basis for Supplier Qualification? Explain why, and indicate which additional standards (list the Ref. numbers) are better suited as the basis for assessment.

blocks.zh: 提示：ISO 9001 是通用品質管理系統，而 IPEC-PQG GMP Guide (Ref. 15)、EXCiPACT (Ref. 13)、NSF/IPEC/ANSI 363 (Ref. 14) 才是賦形劑專用標準。
blocks.en: Hint: ISO 9001 is a general quality management system, whereas the IPEC-PQG GMP Guide (Ref. 15), EXCiPACT (Ref. 13), and NSF/IPEC/ANSI 363 (Ref. 14) are the excipient-specific standards.

blocks.en: Section Summary — Key Points

blocks.zh: 核心記憶框架
blocks.en: Core Memory Framework

blocks.zh: TR54-6 Sections 7–9 一句話記憶法
blocks.en: TR54-6 Sections 7–9 in One Line Each

blocks.zh: Section 7：風險評估是活文件，觸發就重評，一切要文件化
blocks.en: Section 7: The risk assessment is a living document; reassess when triggered; document everything

blocks.zh: Section 8：正式化 RA 的價值 = 知識管理 + 主動決策 + 法規合規
blocks.en: Section 8: The value of a formalized RA = knowledge management + proactive decision-making + regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: Section 9：依據 EU 2015年指引 + ICH Q9 + EXCiPACT / IPEC-PQG / USP <1078>
blocks.en: Section 9: Based on the EU 2015 guidelines + ICH Q9 + EXCiPACT / IPEC-PQG / USP <1078>
